mainEntity.name: What is the cost of GEO visibility services for a dental practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of GEO visibility services for a dental practice varies widely based on the scope of services, the competitiveness of the local market, and the chosen provider. Basic packages might start from a few hundred dollars per month for foundational local SEO. More comprehensive solutions, including advanced content creation, aggressive local link building, and targeted local advertising, can range from $1,000 to several thousands per month. It's an investment tailored to the specific needs and goals of each practice.
acceptedAnswer.description: The cost of GEO visibility services for dentists varies, from a few hundred to several thousand dollars monthly, depending on service scope and market competition.
